name: Dlg Exhibitions & Events Corporation Limited
summary: Dlg Exhibitions & Events Corporation Limited, a company based in China, primarily specializes in the orchestration and management of conventions and trade shows. Its extensive service portfolio encompasses the planning and marketing of sports events, along with the administration of cultural venues. Furthermore, it provides a comprehensive suite of technology-related services, including development, transfer, advisory, support, promotion, and exchange within the exhibition and information sectors. DLG also delivers advertising solutions, from design and production to exhibition and publishing. Its offerings extend to strategic project planning, public relations, business management consultancy, and various business agency functions, complemented by services focused on the application of digital cultural creative content. Beyond these core activities, the corporation facilitates cultural and artistic exchange programs, undertakes graphic design and production, manages residential real estate leasing, and engages in industrial investment. Finally, it ensures comprehensive support for exhibitions, encompassing construction, logistics, and other essential auxiliary services. Established in 1982, DLG Exhibitions & Events Corporation Limited maintains its headquarters in Shanghai, People's Republic of China.
